title: DEMO OUT NOW: I built a Stock Market Survival Game in Godot using 100% Vibe Coding with Claude and Antigravity.
author: PaperPlaneLogic
selftext:
Greetings everyone,

I'm not a developer. I have a background in QA (Testing) and web operations. I've been unemployed for a while and decided to try something during that time.

I developed Neo Capitalist on the Godot engine for 3 months, entirely using Claude and Antigravity for "Vibe Coding," acting as my own QA/Project Manager.

What is the game? Basically, it's a stock market simulation played on a terminal screen. But you're not just buying and selling; you also need to pay your weekly expenses, manage your stress, and take care of your happiness. While it looks like a classic tycoon game, I tried adding survival and roguelite mechanics. Visual assets are almost non-existent; everything runs on code and system mechanics.

Besides the basic stock trading mechanics, there are side mechanics where you can earn extra money, missions, and hidden content you can discover after completing certain stages. You might receive a mission from an unknown person, you might be subjected to a cyberattack, or you might have a chance to manipulate the market if you do certain things right.

I have many more ideas and plans to add to the game. I'll add as many as I can before the full release. Later, I might add them as patches or perhaps free DLC.

As of today, my demo is out on Steam! I've brought it this far with zero budget and a lot of trial and error. I would really appreciate it if you played the demo and gave me feedback. Thanks in advance to everyone who supports me by adding it to their wishlist!

**Steam Link:** [https://store.steampowered.com/app/4580690/Neo\_Capitalist\_\_Stock\_Market\_Survival\_Simulator/](https://store.steampowered.com/app/4580690/Neo_Capitalist__Stock_Market_Survival_Simulator/)
